title: System Report for CCL25-Eval Task 10: Prompt-Driven Large Language Model Merge for Fine-Grained Chinese Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to extract targeted geographic groups and associated hate arguments from Chinese social media text using hard and soft F1-score matching on the STATE-ToxiCN benchmark.
